facts.what: One morning Aris's workshop was found standing open, her tea cold and her tools left on the bench as if she'd stepped out. Nobody saw her leave.

leads.text: Her notes are still on the workshop bench. Read what she wrote last.
Kofi saw her the evening before she went missing. Ask him where she was going.

facts.what: Aris wrote in her notebook: "H. crossed the lane again rather than pass my door." "R. told Mirela I'm not one of us any more."

leads.text: Who's H.? Henrietta never goes near the maker space. Ask her how she got on with Aris.
Who's R.? Raymond has opinions about Aris's bionics. Ask him how he got on with her.

facts.what: Tobias distrusted Aris's bionics and said out loud that she wasn't one of them any more.

leads.text: Raymond walks home down Banyan Row. Ask him whether he saw Aris the evening before she went missing.

facts.what: Kofi saw Aris heading down Banyan Row's steps towards the old metro at about 21:40 the evening before she went missing, with Raymond going the other way.

leads.text: She was heading for the old metro. See whether anything down there remembers her.
Raymond passed her on the steps. Ask him whether he saw her that evening.

facts.what: Raymond passed Aris on Banyan Row's steps that last evening, heading down towards the old metro, and said nothing to her.

known_by.cover: I didn't see her that evening.

leads.text: She was going down to the old metro. See whether anything down there remembers her.

facts.what: The dead terminal in the old metro carries Aris's maker's mark: she rewired it. Its last entry logs the maintenance lift going down to the sewers the night before her workshop was found standing open.

leads.text: The lift went down to the sewers. Take it down and find where she went.

facts.what: A maintenance hatch deep in the sewers is stamped with Apex's mark, and its lock carries Aris's maker's mark: she wired a key of her own into it. Its log shows that key opening it the night before her workshop was found standing open, onto a shaft that climbs towards the Apex towers.
